turns.teacher: Good morning children! Very nice, everyone is sitting so nicely today. Today we will do subtraction. Our first sum is fifty two minus twenty seven, 52-27.
turns.label: other

turns.teacher: Rabi, you wrote 35? No no, that is wrong. Next, Arjun, you tell.
turns.label: move_on_or_scold

turns.teacher: Arjoon, 35 is also not correct. The answer is 25. Fifty two minus twenty seven is twenty five. Everyone say it with me, 25.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: Listen again carefully. 2 is small, so we borrow. 12 minus 7 is 5. Then 4 minus 2 is 2. Answer 25. I am saying it again, LISTEN, 12 minus 7 is 5, 4 minus 2 is 2!
turns.label: repeat_same_way

turns.teacher: Thumbs up if you understood. Very good, so many thumbs!
turns.label: check_whole_class

turns.teacher: Okay, now next sum. Forty three minus eighteen, 43-18. Do it in your notebook quickly.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Mina, you are counting on fingers again and getting 26? Wrong. Don't use fingers, sit properly.
turns.label: move_on_or_scold

turns.teacher: The answer is 25. Forty three minus eighteen is twenty five. Write 25 and repeat after me, 25.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: Who all got 25? Raise your hand. Good, good.
turns.label: check_whole_class

turns.teacher: One more. Sixty one minus thirty four, 61-34. Everybody try, we will check after.
turns.label: new_sum
